GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside Settled Down 2nd last Inside 9 Lengths held together well back to straightening up had too much to do and had Nowhere To Go Until 300m and then was again held-up from 200m to the 50m, Not Knocked About Margin Unfair !!! # maybe wins!
Jumped Ok Went Forward = Lead mid of 3 early Took hold 3rd x 800m 1 Lengths , checked 500m locked away nowhere to go until the 300m kept on okay to 50m, # couldn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 600m had to be checked.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 5l off, eased Wide turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, ran on well took lead late and drew clear # just too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted behind runners from a wide barrier.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat handy 2 Lengths off, much the same turn, Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, battled on well # even effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden with cover; settled off-pace. Near the 50m was corrected after laying in and away from another rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well widest. Crossed Two Wide 2nd, 1 length @ 700m. Ridden Along Under Pressure to home Turn . Gradually Gave Ground Not Knocked About late. Winner Led All The Way (vetted - slow recovery) # sat 2nd/winner led
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rdr std he was required to make use of mnt to cross another rnr nearing the first turn to avoid racing wide without cover. He said mnt came under heavy pressure prior to straightening & was disappointing in manner in which it failed to close race off. A post-race vet exam revealed mare to have a slow post-race recovery. Tnr advised the mare had pleased the stable & a forward showing was expected, but he did not expect it to settle so prominently & it would be his intention to have it ridden more conservatively next start. Tnr rep subsequently reported mare pulled up well.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased back 6l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off all clear, worked home well making good ground without threatening # back/home ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported that from the wide barrier; after beginning on terms with rnrs drawn to her inside, she elected to ride the mare conservatively in the early stages to avoid racing wide and settled near the rear of the field with cover. Std that after travelling well through the middle stages, near the 350m she shifted her mount wider to improve and when balanced in the home straight she was satisfied with how it finished its race off, however, was unable to significantly close the margin to the leading division. A post-race veterinary examination did not reveal any abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along from Outside looking to slot in Settled Down 4th 1x1 3 Lengths off leader/winner , Ridden Along 400 same, kept trying without threatening - # Even Effort
Jumped Ok faced breeze 1 length off, same turn, Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, running on took passing 100m and drew clear # breeze/too good

Began OK. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field on inside (3L from lead). Improved 1/2L on inside midrace & 3 Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pushed along Four Wide @ 300m & pressured @ 250m. In 3 Wide @ 200m & challenged leaders @ 100m. Just shaded late. # Had her chance.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 100m commenced to lay out resulting in its rider having to stop riding and straighten to avoid heels.
